title: When I try to login, I get the following massage  "Due to a network issue, you are unable to login at this time"
content: Internet access is required for all Marvelous Designer license types with the exception of the Enterprise Network Offline License users. Please try restarting Marvelous Designer, or restart your computer. If you are still facing difficulty logging in, please make sure you do not have a VPN turned on. Offline login is available to Marvelous Designer 5-9 users with a perpetual license. If you need to activate license in offline environment, please refer to this[ manual page](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358427341465)
content_description: This page provides troubleshooting steps and licensing information for Marvelous Designer users, including internet access requirements and offline activation instructions.

title: Smooth Curve
content: ### ### ### ### ### ### Objective Round the corner of Patterns and Internal Shapes (ver2.3.0). ### Location Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Smooth Curve 2D Toolbar ▶ Smooth Curve ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Smooth Curve 2D Toolbar ▶ Smooth Curve 2. Click and drag a corner or a curved segment to be rounded. → The selected corner/curved segment is rounded/edited. 3. Right click on the mouse while dragging the point or the curved segment (ver2.4.0). → The Round Corner by Length window appears. 4. Enter the desired line length and curvature. Then, click OK. → The selected corner/curved segment is rounded/edited.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for using the Smooth Curve tool to round corners and edit curved segments in 2D patterns.

title: I got H0033 “Unable to access Sentinel HASP Run-time Environment” error.
content: The error message occurs when HASP driver is installed improperly in your PC. To check if the HASP driver is installed properly in your PC, type http://localhost:1947 or http://127.0.1:1947 in a browser and see if the following image shows up. If you can’t see the image below, it means that the HASP drive is not installed properly. To solve this problem, download HASP driver from the link below and install it. Windows: http://211.191.168.213/data/haspdinst.exe Mac: http://211.191.0.168/213/data/Sentinel_LDK_RTE_Installer.dmg
content_description: This page provides guidance on verifying and resolving issues with the improper installation of the HASP driver on your PC.

title: I got H0040 “Communication error between local and remote Sentinel HASP License Managers” error.
content: The error occurs when the Server PC and the Client PC could not communicate with each other. To solve the problem, 1. Enter “services.msc” in the execution window. 2. Check if Sentinel Local License Manager is “getting started” in the service window. If the status is not “getting started”, click your right mouse button and choose “Start” then restart your computer. 3. If you still have the problem, check if the version of the HASP driver in the Server PC and the Client PC is the same. If they are different, make their version the same. You can get the version information from the image below. 4. If any of the above methods do not work, ask a network expert for help on how to communicate the status between ports such as Server and Client 5. Check if 1947 port is occupied by other services or not.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide to troubleshoot communication errors between a Server PC and Client PC, focusing on the Sentinel Local License Manager and HASP driver compatibility.
